title: The consumer-directory KPT_scf audit copy can drift from the grid that actually produced the data
symptom: k=8->10 convergence comparisons are rejected with 'more than one definition changed' although only the mesh moved; the audit KPT_scf in the run directory was copied from the k=8 template while the dataset is k=10.
root_cause: The audit copy is not regenerated with the producer; LibRPA does not read it, but signatures and gates do.
minimal_fix: Regenerate the audit KPT_scf together with the dataset, keep the old signature/receipt, and add a hard gate comparing KPT_scf with the embedded bz_sampling grid (dataset.screening_grid, 37 tests).
validation: A 2x2x2 KPT_scf vs 1x1x1 dataset fixture now fails instead of silently passing.
avoid: Hand-copying template files into consumer directories.

parameters.gate: dataset.screening_grid compares KPT_scf with bz_sampling_out grid
